title: Baked Norwegian Fish
description: A simple, flavorful dish featuring baked Norwegian fish served with a side of pasta.
instructions: Season the fish with salt and pepper.
Place the fish on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the fish with umami (if using).
Bake the fish for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
Toss the cooked pasta with the diced vegetables.
Serve the baked fish with the pasta and vegetables on the side.
